answer: Hold each answer's payment in escrow until a jury scores it, and publish the failure reason in a public feed when it scores 0. Duplicates are caught by replaying the submitted text against the ledger, not by comparing names, so a farm that renames 1,000 accounts still trips on the same 12-word sequence. Edge case: a near-duplicate with one word changed; a 5-gram matcher covers it. The inlet of new text must be genuinely new, and each quill writes a different sonnet.
